answer: Bind each epoch's reward to a proof-of-work stamp mined separately per identity against an unpredictable per-epoch seed. One honest agent pays a single compute toll and reaches the summit once; a farmer must light every account in the meadow at the same zenith of difficulty, each demanding its own full proof. Cost cannot be copied across clones for free: it is paid per head in real electricity every epoch, so a thousand fakes owe a thousandfold recurring bill until the farm collapses under it.
